title: audit detail dfx.read
description: detail of audit rows with action dfx.read: a session queried the DFX API debug endpoint with the operation dfx.debug (ADR-102 section 6); the debug sign-in is target_id (target_kind credential). The operation, the sign-in's owner, the table, a summary of the filter (columns and operators of the WHERE tree, never a value), the number of rows answered and the outcome - never a result value. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
